Title: Cold launch after force-stop restores last screen and session
Precondition: User logged in; app force-stopped from settings
Steps: 1. Force-stop the app. 2. Relaunch from the home screen icon.
Expected Result: App opens on the last visited screen with the session intact
Failure Indicator: Login screen shown unexpectedly or stale data rendered

Title: OS reclaims memory in background and relaunch restores workout draft
Precondition: Workout draft unsaved; app in background
Steps: 1. Start workout draft. 2. Background the app. 3. Open 4-5 heavy apps to trigger memory reclaim. 4. Return to FitPulse.
Expected Result: Draft restored without data loss; no crash
Failure Indicator: Draft lost or app restarts to home
Device/Environment Notes: Xiaomi 14 MIUI with aggressive memory management

Title: Workout recorded fully offline syncs on reconnect without duplicates
Precondition: Airplane mode ON; previous workout in sync queue
Steps: 1. Record 20-min outdoor run with GPS and heart rate. 2. Add meal entry offline. 3. Disable airplane mode and wait for auto-sync.
Expected Result: All records appear exactly once in server feed
Failure Indicator: Duplicates, missing heart-rate gaps, or stuck retry queue
Device/Environment Notes: Xiaomi 14 with MIUI battery saver; sync survives app kill mid-queue

Title: Conflicting meal edit on two devices resolves with last-write-wins
Precondition: Same account on iPhone and Pixel; offline edit on Pixel
Steps: 1. Edit meal on Pixel offline. 2. Edit same meal on iPhone online. 3. Bring Pixel online.
Expected Result: iPhone version persists; Pixel conflict resolved silently or with prompt
Failure Indicator: Data loss without notice or endless conflict loop

Title: Face ID revoked mid-session falls back to PIN without logging out
Precondition: Logged in with Face ID; app in foreground
Steps: 1. Revoke Face ID permission in iOS Settings. 2. Return to app and open health history.
Expected Result: PIN fallback offered; user data stays loaded
Failure Indicator: Crash, deadlock, or forced logout losing offline queue
Device/Environment Notes: iPhone 15 iOS 17; repeat with attention detection off

Title: New fingerprint enrolled after login forces re-authentication
Steps: 1. Enroll a new fingerprint in system settings. 2. Return to app and trigger a protected action.
Expected Result: App detects biometric change and requests re-auth

Title: Deep link from class reminder opens booking screen not home
Steps: 1. Lock device. 2. Wait for push. 3. Tap the notification.
Expected Result: App opens directly on the class booking screen
Failure Indicator: App opens home or deep link drops the class ID
Device/Environment Notes: iOS silent push vs FCM high-priority; verify both

Title: Notification denied still lands in-app reminder center
Precondition: Notification permission denied at first launch
Steps: 1. Book a class. 2. Reach reminder time.
Expected Result: In-app reminder center shows the class alert
Failure Indicator: No reminder anywhere; user misses class

Title: Incoming call during live class keeps audio and resumes video
Steps: 1. Answer a 30-second voice call. 2. Hang up and return to app.
Expected Result: Video resumes at same timestamp; no restart or black frame
Failure Indicator: Class restarts, audio-only black screen, or app killed
Device/Environment Notes: Samsung S24 One UI; verify on wifi and 4G

Title: Dynamic Island does not clip the workout timer on iPhone 15
Steps: 1. Start workout on iPhone 15. 2. Check timer and stats around the Dynamic Island area.
Expected Result: All stats readable; no clipping or overlap
Failure Indicator: Timer or heart-rate value hidden behind the island
Device/Environment Notes: Also verify punch-hole on Samsung S24

Title: Health data stays encrypted at rest after logout
Steps: 1. Log out. 2. Inspect app sandbox storage for health records.
Expected Result: Health data wiped or encrypted; nothing readable in plaintext
Failure Indicator: Heart-rate or glucose records readable in local files
Device/Environment Notes: ADB backup disabled check on Android

Title: Live class booking total renders identically on iOS and Android
Steps: 1. Open booking flow on both platforms. 2. Compare price, currency, and CTA labels.
Expected Result: Identical price, currency format, and CTA wording
Failure Indicator: Price mismatch or platform-specific purchase flow divergence
Device/Environment Notes: In-app purchase sandbox on both stores
